description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithSmoker' implementing the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to format an entity value into a string indicating 'Smoker' if true, or null if false. The class is part of the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin, specifically within the access strategy formatting namespace.

classes.name: FormatWithSmoker
classes.description: A formatter class that converts a boolean entity value to 'Smoker' string if true, otherwise null.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns 'Smoker' if the input value is truthy, otherwise null.
